digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture teardown; snapshot cleanup; pathlib/os.walk integration
propositions: broad Path.rglob traversal of tmp_path enters unrelated mutable subtree (.tickets-tracker) where canonical lock lifecycle concurrently removes .ticket-write.lock.d, causing Python 3.11 pathlib to raise FileNotFoundError because cached child entry vanished mid-walk

fixture teardown must recursively discover and remove all .rebar/run_snapshots roots below test tmp_path while tolerating only concurrently-disappearing entries, preserving unrelated content, and propagating non-FileNotFoundError scan errors

os.walk with onerror callback tolerates FileNotFoundError for disappeared entries on all Python versions, whereas Path.rglob caches entries and only Python 3.12+ delegates to walk; replacing rglob with os.walk fixes Python 3.11 race

secondary defect: Path(dirpath) factory calls in cleanup fixture and _rmtree_writable raise NotImplementedError on Python 3.11 when test-scoped os.name monkeypatch sets os.name='nt' before teardown, due to ambient pathlib selecting WindowsPath; using type(reference_path)(dirpath) or scoped factory binding preserves intended POSIX behavior

deterministic synchronization barrier with real LockHandle.release() at post-scandir timing reproduces exact FileNotFoundError in fixture, controls for async MCP and lock-lifecycle defects, and validates both disappearing-entry and monkeypatch fixes return to GREEN
